steps.en: Install it with pip, then import it before requests or anything else that opens sockets
steps.zh: 用 pip 装上，并在 requests 等库之前 import 它

steps.en: On import, gevent patches the stdlib so a request waiting on the network yields to the others
steps.zh: import 时由 gevent 给标准库打补丁，等网络的请求会让出控制权

steps.en: Build unsent request objects with the same arguments you would pass to requests
steps.zh: 用和 requests 相同的参数构造还没发出的请求对象

steps.en: Hand the whole batch to map, optionally with a pool size and an exception handler
steps.zh: 把整批交给 map，可选设池大小和异常处理函数

steps.en: Sends them concurrently from a gevent pool inside your one thread
steps.zh: 在你这一个线程里用 gevent 池并发发出

steps.en: Returns Response objects in request order; failures come back as None or your handler's value
steps.zh: 按请求顺序返回 Response，失败的位置是 None 或处理函数的返回值

value.en: Existing synchronous requests code fans out concurrently with a few changed lines — no async/await rewrite, no thread pool
value.zh: 现有的同步 requests 代码改几行就能并发，不用改写成 async/await，也不用自己管线程池

sources: https://github.com/spyoungtech/grequests#usage (grequests.get(u) unsent requests, grequests.map(rs), same keyword arguments as requests)
